title: Generalized linear cellular automata in groups and difference Galois theory II
summary: In the first part of this series the $σ$-ring spanned by the periodic solutions of a generalized linear cellular automaton in a discrete group was shown to be Hopf--Galois, with pro-algebraic Galois group, while a Galois theory for the $σ$-ring spanned by the finite support solutions was left open, with parameterized difference Galois theory suggested as the tool. We apply that tool to automata over $\mathbb Z$.
